I am an environmental epidemiologist at the [Air Pollution Epidemiology Team](https://www.imperial.ac.uk/school-public-health/environmental-research-group/research/air-pollution-epidemiology/), Environmental Research Group, Imperial College London. My work combines **air pollution epidemiology**, **health impact assessment** and **economic modelling** to give policymakers evidence they can act on.

I estimate the health and economic burden of air pollution, particularly NO₂ and PM~2.5~, and evaluate the benefits of policies that reduce exposure. Methodologically, I work with concentration–response functions, lifetable models and economic valuation (VOLY/QALY), and I lead evidence synthesis through systematic review and meta-analysis.

I care about translating technical results into clear, policy-facing outputs, and my work has been covered in the media.
